messages:
Support-Sarah: Customer Acme Ops reports project admins suddenly getting '403 Forbidden' in the Console when attempting edits or deleting API keys. They can view the project but action buttons are greyed and throw 'permission denied'. Ticket C-3872. Started after they renamed an org label via SCIM yesterday. Repro steps attached.

Acme Ops: Acme Ops: Repro steps: 1) Login 2) Switch to prj-acme-prod 3) Click Settings -> Save or Delete API key -> UI shows spinner then error 'You do not have permission (403)'. No role changes from our side.

Maya Chen: Maya Chen: Can you paste org_id and project_id? Any recent admin role edits? :thinking_face:

Support-Sarah: Support-Sarah: org_id: org_78ac, project: prj-acme-prod. They did a SCIM group rename/merge yesterday from idp. No manual role edits.

Ian Patel: Ian Patel: Hypothesis: role-shadowing after SCIM rename. Console cache may still show admin but authz evaluation from token says viewer. Quick check for customer: run `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.com/v1/whoami` and paste response (redact PII).

Acme Ops: Acme Ops: Pasted redacted whoami -> `{"user":"alice@acme.com","roles":["viewer"]}` but in Console Alice is listed as Project Admin.

Alyssa Gomez: Alyssa Gomez: That's the mismatch. Console UI reads cached membership; backend uses live token/role binding. Likely SCIM rename trimmed an IDP attribute so role-hydrator failed to emit project:admin binding. Ask them to force IDP session refresh (logout/login) or re-sync SCIM groups as quick mitigation.

Samir Khan: Samir Khan: Short-term workaround: grant explicit project admin via console API while we investigate: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <org-admin-key>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/orgs/org_78ac/projects/prj-acme-prod/roles -d '{"user":"alice@acme.com","role":"project:admin"}'
```
That will create a binding to unblock deploys.

Maya Chen: Maya Chen: We'll also need to check authz-service logs around the SCIM event time. @eng-sre, can you grep for errors referencing the rename? Suggest looking for `scim:group:rename` / `role-hydrator` / `emit-binding` failures.

eng-sre-bot: eng-sre-bot: Created internal ticket SRE-9421 and linked to C-3872. Assigned to Trevor.

Trevor: Trevor: Found failures in role-hydrator during the group rename window (partial 500s). It left some memberships orphaned which caused tokens to lack project:admin. Plan: run membership backfill + re-emit role-bindings for org_78ac. ETA ~2h. Will post progress.

Support-Sarah: Support-Sarah: Notified customer of workaround and ETA. They approved temporary admin grants for 3 users to unblock urgent deploys.

Trevor: Trevor: Backfill completed and re-emit succeeded. Verified by querying whoami for affected users — now shows "roles":["project:admin","viewer"]. Please have users re-login to refresh tokens.

Support-Sarah: Support-Sarah: Customer confirmed after re-login they can edit settings and delete API keys. Marking thread resolved and will follow up with postmortem & SCIM rename safeguards. :white_check_mark:
